_comment: A local REALITY server, built from vendor/Xray-core, for testing the client end to end.
It exists because the alternative is testing against production: the live node proved the
REALITY layer once, but every later change — VLESS framing, Vision, the data path — needs a
server that can be broken, restarted and instrumented without anyone noticing. The keys here
are generated for this file and are not secret; the uuid is a test identity and nothing else.
dest points at a real site because REALITY needs a real one: a client that fails to
authenticate must receive genuine content, and that is also how a wrong client is diagnosed —
it gets avito, not an error.
minClientVer IS LOAD-BEARING ON AN XRAY OLDER THAN v26.9.9 — see the same paragraph in
test/rig/server.json. Omitted, Xray up to v26.7.28 substitutes 26.3.27 (the branch v26.9.9 keeps
commented out, infra/conf/transport_security.go:117-119) and turns away every client reporting
less, which reads as a broken client rather than as a server setting.
